document:3:187:0.text:
Great and mighty is the bearded craftsman!
Flames dance to your commands!
Volcanoes bow beneath your control! The ores sing praises of your hammer!
The gears marvel at your drive shaft!
Your beard shines brighter than the sun, and endures longer than the time's endless run!
(A large section of illegible text, likely containing hymns of a similar nature)
document:3:187:0.source_cn:
伟大啊，那长胡子的铁锤大工匠！
那火炉的主君！
那山脉的地脉的火山的掌控者——！一切矿石都歌颂你的锤子！
一切齿轮都赞美你的传动轴！
你的胡子比日光更洁白，比时间更漫长！
（大段已不可辨别的模糊文字，能隐约看出都是类似的赞美诗）
